# Phase B valid-path corpus -- Date (c_src/src/jsdate.c). NOTHING HERE MAY THROW.
#
# DETERMINISM RULES OBSERVED HERE:
#   * NO `Date.now()` and NO `new Date()` with zero arguments -- those read the
#     wall clock and would differ between the C run and the Rust run.
#   * The absolute time values all come from explicit millisecond stamps, from
#     `Date.UTC(...)`, or from ISO strings with an explicit `Z`/offset, and are
#     read back with the `getUTC*` accessors and `toISOString`/`toUTCString`.
#   * Local-time accessors and `toString`/`toLocaleString`/`getTimezoneOffset`
#     ARE included: both builds are exercised in the same process, so `TZ` and
#     `LocalTZA()` are identical for both. They are still only ever applied to a
#     fixed timestamp, never to "now".

# ===========================================================================
# new Date(ms): 0, negative, huge, NaN, and the +/-8.64e15 valid-range boundary
# ===========================================================================
new Date(0).getTime()
new Date(0).toISOString()

# ===========================================================================
# new Date(y, m, d, h, mi, s, ms) -- 2..7 arguments, read back in LOCAL time
# (local components are exactly what was supplied, so they are TZ-independent)
# ===========================================================================
var d = new Date(2000, 0); [d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()].join('-')
var d = new Date(2000, 5, 15); [d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()].join('-')
var d = new Date(2000, 5, 15, 13); [d.getHours(), d.getMinutes()].join(':')
var d = new Date(2000, 5, 15, 13, 45); [d.getHours(), d.getMinutes(), d.getSeconds()].join(':')
var d = new Date(2000, 5, 15, 13, 45, 30); [d.getHours(), d.getMinutes(), d.getSeconds()].join(':')
var d = new Date(2000, 5, 15, 13, 45, 30, 250); [d.getSeconds(), d.getMilliseconds()].join('.')
var d = new Date(2000, 5, 15, 13, 45, 30, 250); [d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate(), d.getHours(), d.getMinutes(), d.getSeconds(), d.getMilliseconds()].join('|')
var d = new Date(1970, 0, 1); [d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate(), d.getDay()].join('|')
var d = new Date(2024, 1, 29); [d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()].join('-')
var d = new Date(1999, 11, 31, 23, 59, 59, 999); [d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate(), d.getHours()].join('|')

# two-digit years get +1900 (jsdate.c: `if (y < 100) y += 1900`)
new Date(99, 0, 1).getFullYear()
new Date(0, 0, 1).getFullYear()
new Date(70, 0, 1).getFullYear()
new Date(99.9, 0, 1).getFullYear()
new Date(100, 0, 1).getFullYear()
new Date(-1, 0, 1).getFullYear()

# out-of-range components must overflow into the neighbouring field

var d = new Date(2000, 24, 1); [d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth()].join('-')

var d = new Date(2000, 0, -1); [d.getMonth(), d.getDate()].join('-')

var d = new Date(2000, 0, 1, -1); [d.getDate(), d.getHours()].join('-')
var d = new Date(2000, 0, 1, 0, 60); [d.getHours(), d.getMinutes()].join(':')
var d = new Date(2000, 0, 1, 0, -1); [d.getHours(), d.getMinutes()].join(':')
